newsitem.title: CYPRUS: Cyprus '97 budget foresees deficit increase.
newsitem.headline: Cyprus '97 budget foresees deficit increase.

text.p: Cyprus's state budget for 1997, which foresees increasing the deficit by almost 14 percent over projected figures for 1996, was sent on Thursday to parliament for approval.
Net spending is forecast at 1.48 billion pounds ($3.20 billion) against revenue of 1.09 billion, yeilding a deficit of 388.8 million pounds.
Projected spending for the 1996 year is 1.35 billion pounds, against revenue of 1.01 billion, giving a deficit of 341.7 million pounds.
The budget does not include any provision for tax increases in 1997.
"The spirit governing the budgets, and especially that of the consolidated budget, is one of fiscal discipline," Finance Minister Christodoulos Christodoulou told reporters. ($1=0.46 Cyprus pounds)
